story:
A long run of tiny faceted black beads, so small they catch the light like a fine chain.

At the front, one white pearl sits between gold beads, with two more gold beads spaced out on each side.
adHeadline: One pearl, a line of black
socialCaption: Black bead necklace with one pearl in the middle. Simple enough for every day.
name: Black Bead & Pearl Necklace
materials: Faceted black beads, gold-tone spacer beads, one white pearl, gold-tone clasp and extender
adBody: Tiny faceted black beads with a single white pearl and gold accents at the front. Adjustable with an extender chain.
altText: A fine necklace of tiny faceted black beads laid on grey satin, with one white pearl and small gold beads at the front and a gold clasp and extender chain.

story:
Oval gold links, each one filled with glossy black enamel and joined by small gold rings.

It sits at the collarbone and reads bold from across the room.
adHeadline: Gold and black, link by link
socialCaption: Black enamel link chain. Bold, glossy, and easy to wear with anything.
name: Black Enamel Link Chain
materials: Gold-tone oval links filled with black enamel
adBody: Chunky oval gold links filled with black enamel. A statement chain that sits at the collarbone.
altText: A gold chain of oval links filled with black enamel, displayed on a black necklace bust.

story:
A fine flat gold chain that flashes as it moves, with little drops of black enamel set along it.

Light enough to forget you are wearing it.
adHeadline: A fine chain with a little ink
socialCaption: Fine gold chain with black enamel dots. Wear it alone or layer it.
name: Black Enamel Dot Chain
materials: Flat gold-tone links with small black enamel dots
adBody: Flat gold links that catch the light, dotted with black enamel. Fine, light, and easy to layer.
altText: A fine flat gold chain dotted with small black enamel beads, displayed on a black necklace bust.

story:
Long leaf-shaped gold links, each one stamped flat, with a small black bead between every pair.

It lies flat around the neck and shines when it turns.
adHeadline: Leaf links in gold and black
socialCaption: Leaf-link gold chain with black beads. Flat, shiny, everyday.
name: Black Enamel Leaf Chain
materials: Gold-tone marquise links with black enamel beads between them
adBody: Long leaf-shaped gold links joined by tiny black beads. A flat, shiny chain for every day.
altText: A gold chain of long leaf-shaped links with small black beads between them, on a black necklace bust.

story:
Small faceted black cubes, each one wired on by hand to a fine gold chain, with a little gold bead on either side.

The cubes turn as you move and flash at the corners.
adHeadline: Little black cubes on gold
socialCaption: Hand-wired black cube bead chain on fine gold.
name: Black Cube Bead Chain
materials: Faceted black cube beads, fine gold-tone wire chain
adBody: Faceted black cube beads wired by hand onto a fine gold chain. Clean, modern, and light.
altText: A fine gold chain with faceted black cube beads wired along it, on a black necklace bust.

story:
Round faceted black beads, each one wire-wrapped and linked to the next in gold, rosary style.

Every bead is turned by hand, one loop at a time.
adHeadline: Every bead looped by hand
socialCaption: Rosary-style chain: black beads, gold wire, looped by hand.
name: Black Bead Rosary Chain
materials: Faceted black beads, gold-tone wire links
adBody: Faceted black beads wire-wrapped one by one into a gold rosary-style chain.
altText: A rosary-style necklace of round faceted black beads linked with gold wire, on a black necklace bust.

story:
Faceted green beads and round gold balls take turns along a very fine gold chain.

The green is soft and minty, and the gold keeps it bright.
adHeadline: Mint green and gold, taking turns
socialCaption: Green and gold station necklace. A little color for every day.
name: Green Bead Station Necklace
materials: Faceted green stone beads, gold-tone ball beads, fine gold-tone chain
adBody: Faceted green beads and gold balls spaced along a fine gold chain. Fresh and easy to wear.
altText: A fine gold chain with faceted mint-green beads alternating with round gold beads, on a black necklace bust.

story:
Rough little chips of natural stone, no two alike, each one held between two gold beads on a fine chain.

Green, cream, honey, and moss: the colors of a riverbed.
adHeadline: No two stones the same
socialCaption: Stone chip necklace. Every chip is a different shape and color.
name: Stone Chip Station Necklace
materials: Natural stone chips in green, cream, and amber, gold-tone beads, fine gold-tone chain
adBody: Natural stone chips in green, cream, and amber, spaced along a fine gold chain.
altText: A fine gold chain with irregular natural stone chips in green, cream, and amber, each between two gold beads, on a black necklace bust.

story:
Five strands of small faceted navy beads, gathered into gold end caps and finished with a soft gold cord.

Little stone-set flowers sit across the strands like a brooch.

A chain so fine it disappears on the skin, with tiny gold beads set along it, far apart, like stars.

A carved gold bead in the temple style, with a round cream pearl hanging below it.

The hoop opens and the bead slides off, so one pair of hoops can be orange today and sky blue tomorrow. I keep the beads in a row on the felt: orange, hot pink, lime, purple, pink, sky blue, green, red, cream.

Start with one color or take the whole set.

The Tibetan beads are the heavy, detailed kind: brass wrapped in twisted wire, set with turquoise and coral. On a thin gold hoop, one bead is enough.

They slide off like the other swap beads, so one pair of hoops can carry them all.

name: Single Flower Drops
materials: Enamel flower charms, gold-tone metal, gold french hooks
story:
One flower on one hook. I lay the charms out on the black felt in every color I have, red daisies, green blossoms, violet petals with a yellow heart, and let the pair choose itself.

They are the smallest thing I make and the easiest to wear. A little color at the ear, nothing more.

Thin gold hoops, and a handful of flower charms that slide on and off. Pink blossom today, a yellow one tomorrow, a violet four-petal flower or a green daisy when the mood changes.

One pair of hoops, a different flower whenever you like. These are the ones people ask about.

The orange ones always go first in the fall.

materials: Tibetan-style beads with turquoise and coral inlay, gold-tone wire
story:
The beads are the heavy, detailed kind: dark centers wrapped in twisted gold wire, set with turquoise and coral. I wire-wrap each one into a loop by hand so it hangs cleanly from the hook.

One is all blue-green stones in a gold cage. One has red and turquoise dots between gold swirls. Both feel old in the hand.
